result.stdout:
Run this tool to prejit all *.dll in the current directory

Usage:

  prejitall [path] [path/to/crossgen2] [--nonative] <args for crossgen2>

NOTE: if no args are passed it will try to locate system's crossgen2 automatically or download it.
